```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
```

## Load mutation data

```{r Load mutation data}
# Load data & Rename mutation id
# Downloaded from https://zenodo.org/records/7822002
mut_raw = as_tibble(fst::read.fst('../figurecode/data/20221109_TRACERx421_mutation_table.fst'))

mut_raw$real_mutation_id = paste0(mut_raw$chr, ':', mut_raw$start, '-', mut_raw$stop, ':', 
                                  mut_raw$ref, '->', mut_raw$var, ':', mut_raw$Hugo_Symbol)
```

## Summary

```{r Summary}
# Patients
patients = sort(unique(mut_raw$patient_id))

head(patients)

tail(patients)

length(patients)

# Tumors
tumors = sort(unique(mut_raw$tumour_id))

head(tumors)

tail(tumors)

length(tumors)

# Mutations
muts = sort(unique(mut_raw$real_mutation_id))

head(muts)

tail(muts)

length(muts)
```

## Build mutation matrix

```{r Build mutation matrix}
# Build mutation matrix
mut = matrix(NA, nrow = length(tumors), ncol = length(muts), dimnames = list(tumors, muts))
for (tumor in tumors) {
  curr_muts = mut_raw$real_mutation_id[mut_raw$tumour_id == tumor]
  mut[tumor, ] = muts %in% curr_muts
}


# Check missing value
any(is.na(mut))


# Number of tumors where a mutation appears
ntumor_per_mut = tibble(ntumor = colSums(mut))

ggplot(ntumor_per_mut, aes(ntumor)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = log10(after_stat(count) + 1)), binwidth = 1) +
  labs(x = 'Number of tumors where a mutation appears', y = 'log10(count + 1)') +
  theme_pubr()

# Top-frequency mutations
muts[ntumor_per_mut > 30]


# Number of mutations a tumor has
nmut_per_tumor = tibble(nmut = rowSums(mut))

ggplot(nmut_per_tumor, aes(nmut)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = log10(after_stat(count) + 1))) +
  labs(x = 'Number of mutations a tumor has', y = 'log10(count + 1)') +
  theme_pubr()

# Top-frequency tumors
tumors[nmut_per_tumor > 9000]
```

## Save

```{r Save}
saveRDS(mut_raw, file = 'mut_df.rds')
saveRDS(mut, file = 'mut_mat.rds')
```
